column1: # Experimental profile of Splatoon 2 (European release), update 5.5.2 (v3342336).
# I checked this build on macOS through character creation and the first 3D tutorial motion prompt; complete play and networking are not qualified.
# SDK 3.4.1 / NVN 53.313, Nintendo sead / agl / gsys. Constants come from this build's NPDM and survey; no game-specific code cuts.
# Shader table bytes and shader_note retain their generated labels so their tested shader-input identity remains reproducible.
